mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sql_analysis_history (original_sql, optimized_sql, database_type, syntax_valid, performance_score, risk_level, risk_score, execution_time, analysis_result, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{originalSql}, #{optimizedSql}, #{databaseType}, #{syntaxValid}, #{performanceScore}, #{riskLevel}, #{riskScore}, #{executionTime}, #{analysisResult}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sql_analysis_history ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT id, original_sql as originalSql, optimized_sql as optimizedSql, database_type as databaseType, syntax_valid as syntaxValid, performance_score as performanceScore, risk_level as riskLevel, risk_score as riskScore, execution_time as executionTime, analysis_result as analysisResult, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM sql_analysis_history WHERE database_type = #{databaseType} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, original_sql as originalSql, optimized_sql as optimizedSql, database_type as databaseType, syntax_valid as syntaxValid, performance_score as performanceScore, risk_level as riskLevel, risk_score as riskScore, execution_time as executionTime, analysis_result as analysisResult, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM sql_analysis_history WHERE database_type = #{databaseType} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
